visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female medical professional in a white shirt and glasses points to a large computer monitor displaying a close-up of a patient's face with a prominent sunspot. The office setting is brightly lit with professional studio lighting, and several skincare products, including brands like DRX and AKLIET, are visible on a red desk in the foreground. (2) The doctor sits behind her desk, speaking directly to the camera with an informative expression. She uses hand gestures to emphasize her points while her graphics tablet and keyboard are seen on the desk. The background consists of modern office walls and medical equipment, maintaining a clean and professional atmosphere throughout the scene. (3) A microscopic cross-section of skin tissue appears on the monitor, showing complex cellular layers in shades of magenta and blue. The doctor's hand enters the frame periodically to point at specific dermal structures while she explains the physiological changes. The scene remains focused on the screen and her desk area. (4) A brief B-roll shot shows pedestrians walking along a sun-drenched coastal path with palm trees and a bus in the distance under bright natural daylight. This transition provides contextual background for the discussion on sun exposure. The camera is static, capturing the movement of people in the background. (5) Side-by-side medical comparison photos are shown on the screen, illustrating a patient's skin condition before and after treatment. Text overlays indicate the treatment stages, while the doctor concludes her explanation. The lighting remains consistent, and the focus is on the successful dermatological outcome shown on the monitor.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 這是一種常見的曬斑. (2) [Subtitle]: 大概40幾歲、50幾歲 就會出現 然後病人會覺得越來越大塊. (3) [Subtitle]: 那麼像這樣子的斑點 病人老是說 一定要打雷射嗎 我難道擦藥不可以嗎. (4) [Subtitle]: 那我可以跟你講說 不行 如果剛剛那個病人他去切片 他的病理切片 他應該會類似像這個樣子. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們皮膚科醫生 經常在看這種片子 我們就會覺得說 這不是一個好的皮 而且是一個很老的皮. (6) [Subtitle]: 你看它這個下面紫紫的 這個是我們皮膚的 真皮層的膠原蛋白. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個真皮 已經都完全被液態掉了. (8) [Subtitle]: 它這個是一個受過 非常多太陽光照射 光老化的皮. (9) [Subtitle]: 因為太陽光的關係 變薄皮又往下長. (10) [Subtitle]: 當你在除斑的時候 你不太可能就是說 我今天完全不打雷射 然後我就只擦藥 因為擦不到這麼下面. (11) [Subtitle]: 像這樣子的病人 他可能需要打的雷射次數 可能要2到3次 但是呢就有這些幾個小點點 那個地方就靠擦藥了. (12) [Subtitle]: 例如說我們今天看這個病人 術前是這樣嘛 那術後加擦藥 近乎不見. [Variety]: 術前. [Variety]: 術後+擦藥. [Variety]: 近乎不見. (13) [Logo]: @drx.derm. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
